title:
Easy postpartum freezer meals before baby gets here! Trying to make postpartum a little easier this time by stocking the freezer with quick meals we can reheat (and eat one handed) during newborn & toddler chaos🤝 

FREEZER MEAL BREAKFAST SANDWICHES :makes 24 sandwiches 

Ingredients: 
24 English muffins
12 sausage patties
1.5 lbs of bacon
24 slices of cheese of choice
24 eggs  
Splash of milk 

Mix eggs together with milk & seasonings and cook at 350 for 25 minutes and cut into squares. Add egg patty, cheese slice and choice of meat to English muffin and wrap in foil and store in freezer safe bags.

To Reheat:  air-fry for 5 mins or microwave for 90 seconds🍳

FREEZER MEAL BREAKFAST BURRITOS: makes 24 burritos 

24 tortillas
1-2 lbs of sausage
24 slices of cheese
15 mini potatoes
3 green peppers
1 white onion

Mix eggs together with milk & seasonings and cook at 350 for 25 minutes and cut into squares. Bake potatoes, onion and pepper mixture at 325 for 20 minutes. Add egg patty, cheese slice, potato mixture and choice of cooked meat to the tortilla.(Toast your tortillas first for easy folding🌯) Fold and wrap in foil and store in freezer safe bags. 

To reheat: Air-fry for 5 minutes or microwave for 90 seconds. 

If you’re about to be postpartum too or just want to make your mornings easier, consider this your sign to start freezer meal prepping! 

#freezermeals #postpartumprep postpartum freezer meals, nesting, third trimester, meal prep, pregnancy, postpartum recovery, #creatorsearchinsights #mealprep #postpartummeals

title:
High Protein Frozen Burritos are the Ultimate Meal Prep

Meal prepping and freezing high protein burritos changed the game for me - and was actually the first “meal prep” content I ever made

I had honestly never meal prepped until I realized just how convenient having easy, high protein meals stocked in my freezer was. It made my life SO MUCH easier on days I didn’t feel like cooking

Since I started posting frozen burrito recipes, I’ve received thousands of DMs showing your freezers stocked with 10, 20, 30 and even 100+ of my high protein burritos at a time

If you’re looking to enter the burrito meal prep game, here are my top tips👇

Freeze Your Burritos
- Storing frozen keeps burritos tasting their best, and allows them to last for months. It allows you to prep in huge bulk (think 20-30 burritos/meals at at time) without worrying about them going bad/going uneaten
- Wrap individually and freeze, or place burritos on a sheet pan and toss in the freezer uncovered (“flash freeze”) and then add to a gallon sized bag. Flash freezing first keeps them from sticking together while freezing

Reheat Method
 - Remove your burrito straight from the freezer, wrap in a paper towel, microwave for 1.5-2 minutes to thaw (flip halfway) - the goal is to get the interior softened but not hot. Next, air fry (I usually do 375 degrees for 6-7 minutes), or pan fry until crispy. Your burritos will come out perfectly crisp (not soggy) and taste as good, if not better, than fresh

Slowly Stockpile
- You don’t need to spend hours and hours prepping - start by making 1-2 of my recipes a week (which will usually yield 20-30 burritos/meals). Repeat weekly, rotating recipes based on preference, and you’ll slowly build a huge stockpile of frozen meals. The concept is to be in a “meal prep surplus” - cooking more than you eat each week, until you eventually have enough meals to last for months

Make a Low Calorie Side Sauce
- I like to make simple, high protein yogurt sauces as a pairing. Low fat greek yogurt (and Skyr) taste nearly identical to sour cream - and can also add an additional 10+ grams of protein to your meal for minimal calories. Try mixing plain yogurt or Skyr with your favorite hot sauce for a delicious dipping sauce. If you’re hesitant, start with full-fat greek yogurt (5%) which still has a great protein-to-calorie ratio and tastes incredible

Cool the Filling Before Rolling
- When I prep burritos in bulk, I tend to just mix everything together to create a “filling” instead of adding each ingredient separately. After creating the filling, I like to place it in the fridge/freezer for 15-20 minutes so it can thicken - and it makes rolling burritos perfectly completely effortless

If you’re looking for recipe ideas - I have an entire chapter in my meal prep cookbook dedicated to high protein frozen burrito preps, and tons of recipes on my feed

If you’re hesitant, start with full-fat greek yogurt (5%) which still has a great protein-to-calorie ratio and tastes incredible

Cool the Filling Before Rolling
- When I prep burritos in bulk, I tend to just mix everything together to create a “filling” instead of adding each ingredient separately. After creating the filling, I like to place it in the fridge/freezer for 15-20 minutes so it can thicken - and it makes rolling burritos perfectly completely effortless

If you’re looking for recipe ideas - I have an entire chapter in my meal prep cookbook dedicated to high protein frozen burrito preps, and tons of recipes on my feed

title:
📌Save For: How To Lego Meal Prep

👍Like this post and comment ‘Meal Plan’ for the recipes!

The way I meal prep may have just changed for good when I discovered the concept of lego meals - which blew my mind (inspired by @little.vegan.eats!). This is the perfect solution for families with different meal preferences or for those that like variety throughout the week but still want to meal plan. Also an amazing way to save money and reduce waste.

Basically you make components of the meals and freeze them in individual containers. You can then mix and match meal ingredients based on your preference. Once you are ready to eat, defrost in the microwave and add flavour enhancers like hummus, guacamole or additional herbs and spices.

If you want to meal prep like this, I recommend starting with 3-4 veggies, 2-3 proteins and  1-2 starches. Save this post to steal this meal prep strategy. Have you ever meal prepped liked this?

I used @soupercubes molds for this prep!

- Roasted Peppers

High Protein Mexican Cheesy Beef Burritos!🔥🥩🌯

OVER 50g of Protein! Easy High Protein Burrito Meal Prep 😋

Comment “Cookbook” and I’ll DM you a link to my High Protein Cookbook with 100+ recipes just like this one! 📕👨🏽‍🍳 

Makes 6 Burritos: 🌯🌯🌯🌯🌯🌯

Calories & Macros 📊
Per Burrito: 583 calories 
51g P | 57g C | 15g F

Taco beef 
- 800g lean ground beef (5% or less)
- Taco seasoning (see below) 
- 1 medium red onion (diced)
- 1 red bell pepper (diced)
- 200g fajita sauce (brand: old el paso)
- cooking spray

Taco seasoning (homemade)
- 2 tsp paprika
- 2 tsp garlic powder
- 1 tsp onion powder
- 1 tsp cayenne
- 1 tsp cumin
- 1 tsp oregano
- 2 tsp salt
- 1 tsp black pepper

Mexican red rice
- 15g light butter
- 200g washed rice
- ½ tsp garlic powder
- ½ tsp onion powder
- ½ tsp cayenne
- 1 tsp salt
- 35g tomato paste
- 400ml chicken stock (brand: oxo)

Other ingredients
- 6 protein tortillas (brand: mission) - sub with low carb tortillas
- 180g low fat cheese

Extra Notes ✍🏽
- toast in the pan (optionally with butter) folded side down to seal the burrito
- Allow the burritos to cool before wrapping in foil

Storage & Heating ♨️
- Wrap in foil and store in the fridge for up to a week or in the freezer for a couple months
- To reheat, remove the foil, wrap in a damp paper towel and microwave for 3-4 minutes from the fridge or 5-6 minutes from the freezer, flipping over at halfway, unwrap carefully from the paper towel air-fry or toast in the pan for a couple minutes to get crispy and enjoy!

title:
Bibimbap Meal Prep 101 (10 servings)

1 cup = 240ml
1 T = 15ml
1 t = 5ml

Ingredients for 10 servings

- Uncooked rice: 650g (3.5 cups)
- Bean sprouts 500g
- Spinach 300g
- 1 White radish (about 500g)
- 1 Carrot (300g)
- Mushrooms 400g (I used shiitake, but any sauté-friendly mushrooms work: button, king oyster, enoki, etc.)
- 1 Zucchini (500g)
- Minced garlic

⸻

🌶️ Yak-Gochujang ( Bibimbap Sauce )

Ingredients
- Ground pork 300g
- Minced garlic 3T
- Light soy sauce 2T (i used Sempio 701)
- Sugar 2T
- Gochujang 1 cup
- Water 400g
- Vinegar 2T (white or rice vinegar etc, i used rice vinegar)
- Sesame oil 2T

Recipe
1. Brown the ground pork over medium-high heat.
2. Add garlic and sauté for about 1 minute (don’t burn it).
3. Add soy sauce, sugar, and gochujang. Sauté for 1 minute. (Pour soy sauce along the edge of the pan to boost aroma.)
4. Add water and dissolve the gochujang.
5. Turn off heat. Once slightly cooled, mix in vinegar and sesame oil.

⸻

🥬 Banchan (Side Dishes)

1️⃣ Sautéed Zucchini
- Slice zucchini (fan shape or julienne)
- Sauté with 3T oil over medium-high heat for 3 minutes
- Add salt (2g)
- Finish with 1t sesame oil

⸻

2️⃣ Sautéed Carrots
- Thinly julienne carrots
- Sauté with 3T oil for 3 minutes
- Add salt (2g)
- Finish with 1t sesame oil

⸻

3️⃣ Sautéed Mushrooms
- Slice mushrooms thinly
- Sauté with 3T oil for 4 minutes
- Add salt (2g) and black pepper
- Add 1t minced garlic at 3-minute mark
- Finish with 1t sesame oil

⸻

4️⃣ Bean Sprouts Namul
- Blanch bean sprouts for 1–2 minutes
- Mix with : Minced garlic 1T + Sesame oil 1T + 3 pinch of salt (4g)

⸻

5️⃣ Spinach Namul
- Blanch spinach for 30 seconds
- Rinse in cold water and squeeze dry
- Mix with   : pinch of salt (1g) + Minced garlic ½T + Sesame oil 1T

⸻

6️⃣ Mu-Saengchae
- White radish 500g (julienne shape)
- Gochugaru 2T (30g)
- Minced garlic 4T (60g)
- Minced ginger 10g (optional)
- Sugar 2T
- Salt 1T
- Chopped green onion (optional)
- Vinegar 1T
- Mix everything and let it sit for about 3 minutes.

⸻

🍱 How to Enjoy Bibimbap Meal Prep
- Fridge: Eat within 3–4 days → Microwave for 2–3 minutes before eating
- Freezer: Store longer-term if needed
- Feel free to swap or add any side dishes you like.
- Bibimbap is flexible — use what you love.

- Mix with   : pinch of salt (1g) + Minced garlic ½T + Sesame oil 1T

At this point we ALL need to work together to lower costs for Georgians !

#ossof #healthyrecipes #cajunchicken #onepot #foodie

Cajun Chicken & Rice 

Ingredients:

Chicken marinated: 
2 Lbs Bonless skinless chicken thighs 
1/2 Tbsp Sazon tropical 
1/2 Tbsp Smoked paprika 
1/2 Tbsp ( low sodium) cajun seasoning 
2 Tbsp Olive oil 

Other ingredients 
1 tbsp Olive oil 
1 tbsp butter 
1/2 red or yellow onion diced 
2 Tbsp Minced garlic 
2 cup cooked white rice 

Cream Sauce 
2 Tbsp Butter 
1/2 a lemons juice 
1 Tbsp Garlic powder 
2 Tsp Tablespoons cajan seasoning 
1/2 tbsp Smoked paprika 
1 cup Heavy cream 

Instructions:
1. Start by marinating your thighs with the chicken marinade above! (allow to marinate for thirty minutes to twenty four hours in the refrigerator)
2. After the chicken is marinated melt down butter in a pan along with olive oil, 
3. Once  your butter begins to bubble add in your chicken and cook on each side for 5 to 7 minutes on medium heat for a total of 10 to 14 minutes or until internal temperature of 165° F
4.  Next remove your chicken from the pan
5. In clean pan melt down your butter add in your diced onions, minced garlic, and a pinch of Cajun seasoning & sauté for 60 seconds on medium heat 
6. Once your garlic and onions become fragrant, add in cooked rice and mix until all your rice is well coated with seasoning and remove from heat

Cream sauce 
1. For your cream sauce in a medium sauce pan, meltdown,your butter over medium to low heat, and adding all your ingredients for your cream sauce whisk and stir continuously until your sauce thickens, and is able to coat the back of your spoon
2. Add to chicken back into your rice and top with your cream sauce and enjoy!!

title:
New York Times Highest Rated Healthy Recipes | Coconut Curry Chickpeas @nytcooking @clarkbar

- 3 tbsp oil
- 1 onion
- 2 jalapeños,
- 1 bay leaf
- 1 inch ginger
- 4 garlic
- 1½ tsp garam masala
- 1 tsp ground cumin
- ½ tsp ground turmeric
- 2(15-ounce) cans chickpeas, rinsed
- 13.5-ounce can coconut milk
- 13.5-ounce can pumpkin purée
- 1½ tsp salt
- ¾ cup chopped cilantro,
- lime juice

Sauté the onion, jalapeño, and bay leaf in a large skillet over medium-high heat until the onion edges are golden, then stir in the ginger, garlic, and ground spices (garam masala, cumin, and turmeric) until fragrant. Next, add the chickpeas, coconut milk, pumpkin, water, and salt, bringing the mixture to a simmer for 10 minutes to allow the flavors to meld. Once thickened, finish the curry by stirring in fresh cilantro and lime juice to taste, and serve warm over a bed of rice or couscous with extra lime wedges on the side.

#cooking #healthyrecipe #curry #chickpeas #pumpkin

title:
Healthy Recipes to Beat the Cost of Living Crisis Pt.217	

💾 Save this recipe for later!
Recipe 217: Protein Breakfast Boats

If you want recipes just like this, you can find them in my recipe ebook using the link in my bio! 

Shout out to @gymtrav for the recipe inspo with this one 

Calories & macros 📊
260 calories
21g P | 24g C | 10g F 
Per serving

Ingredients:
Makes x 8 (macros per half quiche) 

6 medium eggs (£1.35) 
160g ham trimmings, diced (£1.00)
150g plum tomatoes, sliced (£0.38)
150g washed & sliced spinach (£0.68)
Taco boats (Old El Paso - £2.75) 
Taco seasoning (incl with above) 
1 tub (300g) low fat cottage cheese (£0.89)
150g salsa (£0.48)
136g low fat cheddar (£1.19)

Total cost: £8.72 (excl. seasonings) 
Cost per serve: £1.09

Method: 
1. Preheat your oven to 180 degrees Celsius 
2. Add all of your ingredients, apart from your taco boats and cheese, into a large mixing bowl. Season with salt, pepper and the packet of taco seasoning. Mix well until fully combined. 
3. Lay out your taco boats onto a baking tray. Spoon 1/8 of the mix into each of the boats until all of the egg mixture has been used. 
4. Level it out and then top each one with 18g low fat cheddar. 
5. Bake in the oven for 20-25 minutes or until the egg has fully set and the cheese has melted.
6. I garnished mine with extra salsa, a tsp of fat free greek yoghurt and fresh coriander. If you are meal prepping. Add this fresh just before serving.
7. Serve and enjoy! 

These can be stored for a maximum of 4 days in the fridge and can be frozen for up to 2 months.

title:
CHICKEN THAT DOESNT SUCK. This is one of the best 1 pan chicken recipes you’ll make. The secret is the marinate that will elevate the chicken and the quick garlicky herb sauce is unbelievably good! 

I’m using bone-in skin-on chicken thighs to make the chicken more flavorful and juicy, but you can remove the skin if you prefer, too.

I paired this with a simple salad, but it would be complete with some regular rice, quinoa, or if you’re doing lowcarb/keto, some of my lowcarb @kaizenfoodco rice.
.
This is how I made it (feel free to multiply for more)
.
1.Grab 4 skin-on bone-in chicken thighs, dab them dry with a paper towel and add them to a bowl.
.
2.For the marinade, grab a medium mixing bowl. Add 2 tbsp drizzle of olive oil, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 4 minced garlic cloves, the zest and juice of 1 large lemon, a couple generous pinches salt, pepper, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp oregano or thyme, 1/4 to 1/2 tsp cayenne pepper. Mix it really well.
.
3.Add the marinade to the chicken, and mix really well covering all sides. Let this ideally sit for 2 to 6 or ideally, overnight.
.
4.Preheat oven to 410F. Remove chicken from fridge and let it come up to room temp before putting in the oven.
.
5.Place chicken on a wire rack and put it in the oven at 410F for 35-40 mins.
.
6.While thats going, make your sauce. I processed together 3 tablespoons of thick greek yogurt (or labneh), a handful of fresh mint (about 3 tablespoons), 2 scallions (green and white part), 1/2 large jalapeño, 1 tbsp olive oil, the juice of half a lemon, and a couple generous pinches of salt + pepper. Process well, taste, and adjust to your preference.
.
7.Remove the chicken from the oven, plate it. Again, you can serve this with whatever base you like (it would be delicious with regular rice, quinoa, or if you’re lowcarb/keto my high protein kaizen rice), some salad of choice, and this sauce.
.
If you make it, be sure to let me know on SHREDHAPPENS. ENJOY!
.
.
.
.

title:

What you need:
• 400 g sweet potato
• 300 g ground beef
• 6 slices cheese
• 8 slices mozzarella cheese

Macros per serving:

Ingredients per 2 servings:
- 10 oz thinly sliced eye of round beef (shabushabu)
- 2/3 cups jasmine rice, uncooked/raw
- 1/3 cup beef bone broth
- 2 tbsp soy sauce
- 1 tbsp mirin
- 1/2 tsp dashi powder
- 1 yellow onion
- 1/2 tbsp ginger

Toppings:
- 2 eggs (boil for 6 min)
- 1 green onion

1. Thinly slice the green onions. 
2. Wash your rice with water. 
3. In your rice cooker add your uncooked rice, beef, beef bone broth, soy sauce, mirin, dashi powder, yellow onion, and ginger. 
4. Cook for 30 minutes in your rice cooker. 
5. In a pot of boiling water, boil your eggs for six minutes, then immediately transfer to an ice bath to make jammy eggs.

title:
street corn chicken bowls 🌽
this recipe makes 2 servings!! 

calories for 1 bowl: 630 ✅

ingredients ⬇️
2 chicken boneless breasts 
2 tsp salt

1 tsp garlic & herb seasoning 

street corn ⬇️
2 cups of cooked sweet corn

1 tbsp cotija cheese

2 tsp chili powder 
1-2 tsp salt 
1 tbsp cilantro 
tajin seasoning for topping (optional)

assemble the 2 bowls. 

enjoy 🌽🍗

title:
Hassle back potatoes with creamy Cajun chicken and airfried brocollini . Easy, healthy comfort meal 

Potato recipe
6 medium potatoes
3 tbsp butter (melted)
2 tbsp olive oil
4–5 cloves garlic (minced)
1½ tsp paprika
1½ tsp onion granules
1½ tsp garlic granules
1 tsp dried parsley
Salt & pepper
1–2 tsp all-purpose seasoning
Method:
Slice each potato thinly (don’t cut all the way through).
Mix melted butter, olive oil, garlic, and all seasonings.
Brush generously over all 6 potatoes, getting into the layers.
Air fry at 180°C for 35–45 mins (depending on size).
Brush with extra butter halfway through for that crispy finish.

Chicken recipe 
Ingredients:
1 tbsp olive oil
1½ tsp Cajun seasoning
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
1 tsp paprika
1 tsp onion powder
Method:
Add the sliced chicken to a bowl.
Drizzle over the olive oil.
Sprinkle all the seasonings evenly.
Mix well until every piece is fully coated.
Let it sit for 10–15 minutes (optional, but boosts flavor).
Pan-fry on medium-high heat until golden and cooked through.

Cajun Sauce:
1 tbsp butter
½ onion (diced)
150–200ml heavy cream
Same seasonings as chicken
Instructions 
In the same pan, melt butter and cook onions until soft.
Add cream + seasoning, simmer until thickened.
Add chicken back in and coat in sauce.

title:
Cabbage Rolls 🥬#sugarfree #lowcarb #prediabetes

Healthy and delicious cabbage rolls that are sugar-free and super low in carbs. Perfect for a complete dinner that keeps my husband's glucose stable and leaves us feeling super satisfied.

INGREDIENTS:
🥬 Filling:
8 oz white button mushrooms, diced
1 lb ground chicken
3 green onions (white parts chopped for the filling, green parts for garnish)
4 large garlic cloves, minced
1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce (or coconut aminos)
⅛ tsp sesame oil
⅛ tsp ginger powder
1 tsp salt (or to taste)
Pinch of black pepper
Avocado oil for cooking

🥢 Sauce:
2 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce
1 tbsp allulose
1 tsp rice vinegar
¼ tsp sesame oil
⅛ tsp garlic powder
1 tsp green onions (green parts), diced
Pinch of black pepper

✨ For Assembly & Serving:
1 large Napa cabbage
Sesame seeds and the green parts of the green onions for garnish

Instructions:
1. FILLING: Heat a drizzle of avocado oil in a skillet. Add the diced mushrooms with a little salt and cook until they have released all their water. Add the white parts of the green onions and the garlic, and cook for another minute. Season with pepper, ginger powder, and soy sauce. Add the ground chicken and cook until it is well done. Remove from the heat and stir in the sesame oil.

2. CABBAGE: While the filling is cooking, boil the cabbage leaves in water for about 5-10 minutes, or until the white part is tender and bendy. Carefully remove them and pat them very dry with a paper towel.

3. ASSEMBLE & COOK: Place about 1 ½ tablespoons of filling on each cabbage leaf and roll it up. In a clean skillet over medium-high heat, pan-fry the rolls on all sides until golden brown.

4. SAUCE & SERVING: In a small bowl, mix all the sauce ingredients. Serve the rolls hot, pour the sauce over them, and garnish with the green parts of the green onions and sesame seeds.

title:
High-protein chicken Alfredo bake 🤍
This is SO creamy and decadent you’d never guess it’s a lighter swap… and it comes together in no time! .

High-Protein Chicken Alfredo Bake

Ingredients (Serves ~6)

* 2-3 cups steamed broccoli (bite-size, cooked until al dente)
* ~20 oz cooked rotisserie chicken breast, shredded or chopped
* 160g Trader Joe’s Lite Shredded Mozzarella (about 1 ⅓ cups), divided
* 2.5 oz grated Parmesan cheese, divided

Sauce:

* 1 (15 oz) jar Rao’s Alfredo Sauce
* 1 cup Fairlife Reduced Fat Milk
* 1 cup (8 oz) Good Culture Low-Fat Cottage Cheese
* garlic powder, to taste
* onion powder, to taste
* salt, to taste
* black pepper, to taste

⸻

Instructions

1. Preheat oven to 375°F.
2. Add steamed broccoli to the bottom of a 10x7 casserole dish.
3. Sprinkle half of the mozzarella and Parmesan over the broccoli.
4. Layer the cooked chicken evenly on top.
5. In a bowl, mix together the Alfredo sauce, milk, cottage cheese, and seasonings until smooth and well combined.
6. Pour the sauce evenly over the casserole, gently poking around so it settles throughout (no need to fully mix).
7. Top with the remaining mozzarella and Parmesan.
8. Bake uncovered for 35 minutes, or until hot and bubbly.
9. Broil for 2–3 minutes until the top is golden and slightly crispy.

⸻

Calories & Macros (per serving, ~6 servings)

* Calories: ~385
* Protein: ~47g
* Carbs: ~8–10g
* Fat: ~18g

(Will vary slightly depending on exact chicken + cheese brands)

title:
Double Chocolate Banana Bread 🍫🍌 A healthier banana bread recipe with all the chocolate flavors you could ask for - and honestly, it might be the best banana bread I've ever made.

I love having a sweet treat at home that I can enjoy as a daily dessert. Balance isn't about restriction, it's about finding recipes like this that satisfy your cravings with better ingredients.

Ingredients:
* 2 very ripe bananas
* 50g butter or coconut oil, melted
* 120ml milk of choice
* 1 tsp vanilla extract
* 190g flour
* 1 tsp baking soda
* 1/4 tsp salt
* 40g cocoa powder
* 100g coconut sugar or brown sugar
* 1 chia egg (1 tbsp chia seeds + 3 tbsp water)
* 100g chocolate chunks

Instructions: 

Preheat oven to 175°C and line your loaf pan with baking paper.

Prepare your chia egg and set aside.

Mash the bananas, then add the melted butter or oil, milk, and vanilla. Mix until smooth.

In another bowl, sift the flour and cocoa powder. Add baking soda, sugar, and salt. Mix well.

Add the chia egg and dry ingredients to the wet mixture. Whisk gently until smooth but don't overmix.

Fold in chocolate chunks and pour into the loaf tin.

Bake for 40-55 minutes. Test at 40 minutes with a knife - if it comes out clean, it's ready.

Let it cool completely before slicing or you'll have a delicious mess on your hands and a crumbled cake in front of you

title:
Crispy Rice Salad 🍚🥗

Crunchy, fresh, creamy, spicy… this Crispy Rice Salad has EVERYTHING

INGREDIENTS
Crispy Rice:
1 cup cold, cooked rice (day-old for best texture)
1 tbsp chili oil
1 tsp soy sauce

Salad Base:
1 cups cucumbers, thinly sliced
1 avocado, sliced 
1 cup cooked shrimp or protein of your choice
1/2 cup shelled edamame (cooked)
1-2 green onions, thinly sliced

Optional Add-Ins:
Fresh herbs: cilantro or mint
Lime wedges, for serving
Sesame seeds 

Peanut Dressing:
1/2 cup peanut butter
1 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp honey or maple syrup
1/2 tbsp toasted sesame oil
2 garlic cloves, finely minced
1-2 tbsp warm water (to loosen)

⸻

INSTRUCTIONS
Rice → Toss rice with chili oil, and soy sauce. Spread in a thin layer on parchment and air fryer at 400°F (200°C) for 14-18 minutes, until deep golden and crispy edges.

Dressing → Whisk everything until smooth and pourable. Add water slowly until it’s creamy but not thick.
*Taste check: salty + sweet + tangy + nutty. Adjust with lime or honey if needed.

Salad → In a large bowl, combine all salad ingredients.

Finish → Fold in the crispy rice last so it stays crunchy. Drizzle dressing on top. Finish with herbs, sesame seeds, and a squeeze of lime.

⸻

title:
this baked feta, chicken & quinoa with veggies has over 8 million views and so many remakes…for good reason!! it’s so easy, delish, & makes for perfect leftovers 🍅🍃🥦    

here’s everything you need:
- 1 cup (8oz) feta cheese (block is best but crumbled works)
- 2 tbsp olive oil
- 1 cup cherry tomatoes
- 2 cups chopped broccoli florets
- 1 +1/2 lbs boneless chicken breast
- 1 tsp salt
- 1/2 tsp black pepper
- 2 tsp garlic powder
- 1/2 cup fresh basil leaves
- 1 cup cooked quinoa

Preheat oven to 400 degrees. In a large casserole dish, add the feta block, olive oil, cherry tomatoes, broccoli, and chicken, spacing the chicken evenly and placing the feta in the middle.

Cover everything with the salt, pepper, and garlic powder and toss to coat.

Bake for 30 minutes, or until chicken temp is 160 degrees. If you need to cook the quinoa, do so while this bakes. After removing from the oven, take out the chicken and slice or shred it.

Mix everything together well in the casserole dish without the chicken, then add in the basil and quinoa and stir again.

Add the chicken back in, top with some extra oil and basil if desired, and serve. The recipe makes 4 servings and stores well in the refrigerator for 3-4 days in an airtight container.

enjoy!! 💕

Lu is here to the rescue!! This bowl took under 15 minutes to make and it genuinely tasted just like a cheesecake, i was in shock.

strawberry shortcake yogurt bowl 🤍

Ingredients:

* about 5 medium strawberries
* juice of ½ lemon
* drizzle of honey
* 2–3 shortbread biscuits

Method:

chop strawberries

add lemon juice + a drizzle of honey

lightly mash some of the strawberries

you want mostly intact pieces, some soft jammy pieces + glossy pink juice

leave for 5-10 mins

add yogurt to a bowl and let some of the pink juice run into the yogurt

crush shortbread into crumbs + chunks and scatter over the bowl

title:
🥒HIGH PROTEIN CHICKEN SALAD CUCUMBER ROLLS.
.
If you are tight on time but still want to eat a ridiculously good high protein meal, checkout this chicken salad. I ate it as cucumber rolls and these were amazing.
.
Here is how to make it:

1. Start with 1lb of cooked, shredded chicken (I just shredded 4 cooked chicken breasts, but rotisserie works too). Shred with two forks or thinly dice it up.
2. Finely dice 1/2 a red onion and soak it in 2 cups of water for 10 minutes to mellow the flavor, then drain and add to a bowl.
3. Chop a handful of fresh cilantro, cube 1 avocado, and toss both into the bowl.
4. For the dressing, blend together: 5 tbsp cottage cheese, 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp onion powder, juice of 3 limes, a handful of cilantro, a generous couple pinches salt, and pepper. Taste and adjust seasoning.
5. You can eat this on its own, in bread, a lettuce wrap—or roll it up in cucumbers like I did.

Here is how to roll it up:
6. Thinly slice a large English cucumber using a peeler.
7. Lay the slices on parchment paper, slightly overlapping by about 1/3.
8. Pat the cucumber dry with a paper towel.
9. Spread 2 tbsp of whipped cream cheese over the cucumbers.
10. Add 4oz of the chicken mix at the bottom, leaving space on all sides. Top with some onion and avocado slices.
11. Roll it up tight—start from the bottom, fold over the toppings, and continue to roll carefully, pressing down to pack it nice and tight.
12. Slice the roll with a sharp knife, then top with everything bagel seasoning and chipotle hot sauce.

If you make it, be sure to let me know what you think on SHREDHAPPENS
.
.
.
.
.

title:
Healthy & Quick Tuna Spread 😊

Ingredients:
	•	1 cucumber
	•	3 boiled eggs
	•	1 can of tuna (about 200 g), drained
	•	1 tablespoon cream cheese
	•	Spices to taste

Instructions:
	1.	Boil the eggs, let them cool, and chop finely. Peel the cucumber and dice it into small pieces.
	2.	Drain the excess liquid from the tuna.
	3.	In a bowl, combine the tuna, chopped eggs, and cucumber.
	4.	Add the cream cheese and mix everything well until combined.
	5.	Season with spices to taste and mix again.

This spread tastes especially good on dark/whole-grain bread 😉

Cooking time: about 10 minutes.

title:
HEALTHY GREEK CHICKEN & RICE BOWL 🔥

I’ve lost over 120lbs eating high-protein, low-carb meals like this, so I know what it’s like to want healthy food that tastes GOOD! After you make this, you’ll realize eating healthy can taste amazing and still be super filling.

I made this one extra high protein and low carb with my @Kaizen Food Company rice, but you can use regular rice, quinoa, cauliflower rice, or brown rice depending on your own goals.

Here’s how I made it:

1️⃣ Add 2 lb boneless chicken thighs to a bowl. Mix with 2 tbsp Greek yogurt, 1 tbsp olive oil, juice and zest of 1 lemon, 3 minced garlic cloves, 1 tbsp oregano, 1 tsp sweet paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, salt and pepper. Cover and marinate at least 2 hrs or overnight if you can.

2️⃣ Heat a pan over medium with 1/2 tbsp olive oil. Cook chicken about 4-5 minutes per side with the lid on then flip back and forth 1–2 minutes each side until cooked through.

3️⃣ Make a quick Greek salad by finely dicing 1-2 Persian cucumbers, 1 green bell pepper, and 1/2 red onion. Add a small handful of quartered cherry tomatoes, 2 tbsp chopped Kalamata olives and 1 oz crumbled feta. Toss with 1-2 tbsp olive oil, juice of 1 lemon or small splash of red wine vinegar, a small pinch oregano, salt, pepper, and a handful of chopped flat-leaf parsley.

4️⃣ For the tzatziki, grate 1 cucumber and squeeze out liquid (optional). Mix with 1 cup Greek yogurt, 1 tbsp olive oil, juice of 1/2 lemon, 1 grated garlic clove, 2 tbsp fresh dill, salt and pepper until creamy.

5️⃣ Cook or prep your base. I cooked up my Kaizen lowcarb rice, or make your rice of choice.

6️⃣ Assemble the bowl: rice on the bottom, 4-5oz chicken, a big scoop of the Greek salad, and a generous dollop of tzatziki. Sprinkle extra parsley or dill to finish.

If you make it, be sure to let me know what you think on SHREDHAPPENS!

ENJOY! 🙌

- Gnocchi und Brokkoli gleichzeitig in die Pfanne geben, 200ml Gemüsebrühe hinzugeben

- Protein-Sahne nach Packungsangabe vorbereiten und hinzugeben

title:
RECIPES + MACROS 👇

Caesar Loaded Potatoes 🥔

This dish has me dancing2 @keliholiday 

If you love Caesar salad, this one’s gonna be your new obsession 🤤

Ingredients (for 2 serves)
🥔 400 g baby potatoes
🥔 100 g bacon
🥔 250 g chicken breast
🥔 3 cups shredded lettuce
🥔 Garlic powder, paprika, salt + pepper
🥔 Avocado oil
🥔 125 g Greek yoghurt
🥔 1 tsp Dijon mustard
🥔 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce
🥔 3½ tbsp parmesan cheese (3 in sauce + ½ tbsp to top each serve)

Instructions
1️⃣ Air fry potatoes at 200°C for 15 mins with avocado oil, garlic powder, paprika, salt + pepper until golden.
2️⃣ Fry bacon until crispy, then set aside.
3️⃣ In the same pan, cook chicken with oil, garlic powder, paprika, salt + pepper until golden.
4️⃣ In a bowl, mix Greek yoghurt, Dijon, Worcestershire sauce + parmesan to make the creamy Caesar sauce.
5️⃣ Stir through shredded lettuce.
6️⃣ Layer potatoes → salad → chicken → bacon, then sprinkle with parmesan to serve.

Macros (per serve)
🔥 469 cal
💪 47 P
🍚 27 C
🥑 17 F

title:
Easy Healthy Lunch or Dinner 🍗🥗
Save this recipe so you don’t lose it!

Ingredients:
• 2 chicken breasts
• 3–4 tbsp Greek yogurt
• 2 tomatoes
• 1 egg
• 3–4 tbsp ground oats (as a flour or breadcrumb substitute)
• ~100 g cheese (to taste)
• Salt, pepper, paprika, garlic — to taste

Preparation:
Blend the chicken breasts into a smooth mince and season with salt.
Grind the oats into fine flour.
Form little “pockets,” as in the video: a layer of chicken mince, then sour cream, tomato, and a bit of cheese, followed by another layer of mince. Brush with egg and sprinkle with the oat “flour.”
Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 25–30 minutes.

Serve with salad or any vegetables you like.
A light, high-protein, and filling dish without frying — perfect for lunch or dinner! 😋#CapCut

title:
Date night idea 🥹♥️ Taco Beef Mince Loaded Sweet Potato Nachos

✨ Macros per portion: 514 kcals | 47g protein | 42g carbs | 19g fat

Ingredients
600g sweet potato
500g 5% lean beef mince
120g avocado
40g grated Red Leicester cheese
40g reduced fat mature cheddar
40ml sour cream
1 tsp paprika 
Salsa (ingredients: tomatoes, coriander, red onion & lime juice) 
Seasonings: smoked paprika, garlic powder, cumin, chili powder (to taste) OR use one packet of tacos seasoning for ease 
Optional: fresh coriander, jalapeños, squeeze of lime

Method
1. Preheat oven to 200°C (fan). Slice sweet potatoes into thin slices, drizzle lightly with oil, season with salt + paprika, then bake for 20–25 mins until golden and crisp.
2. In a pan, fry the beef mince. Season with the taco seasoning. Cook until browned.
3. Once the potato’s are cooked, add the beef mince, then sprinkle over both cheeses. Place back in the oven for 5 mins until the cheese is melted.
4. Meanwhile make the salsa by mixing together tomatoes, red onion, coriander & lime juice. 
5. Top the nachos with avocado, salsa and sour cream
6. Serve straight from the tray! 

#HealthyNachos #DateNightEats #SweetPotatoNachos #HighProteinMeals #TacoVibes

title:
Peach Cobbler Overnight Oats 🍑
Stewed peaches: 
- however many peaches you want, I would say about 1 peach per serving, cut into small cubes 
- In a small sauce pan heat 1tsp of coconut oil 
- Add in the peaches, a dash of cinnamon and 1 tbps of maple syrup and stir on medium heat until peaches are nice and soft. About 5ish minutes. 
- Set aside 

Oats:
- 1/2 cup of rolled oats 
- 1/2 cup of skyr or Greek yogurt 
- 5oz of milk of choice (I used almond) 
- Stir of this together until well combined
- Add in 1 tbps of chia seeds or basil seeds and stir again 
- Add 1 tsp of vanilla extract, dash of cinnamon, and 2tsp of maple syrup (or more if you like it sweet) 
- Top with the stewed peaches and set in fridge overnight! 
#recipesoftiktok #overnightoats #peaches #healthy #breakfastideas

title:
High Protein Chicken Gyros! 🌯 82g of Protein 🤯💪🏼 Ingredients 👇🏼 (chicken & marinade)
- 180g Thinly Cut Chicken Breast (raw weight) (Brand: Macrofoods Skinless Chicken Breast)
- 100g Low Fat Greek Yoghurt (Brand: YoPro)
- Squeeze Of Lemon Juice
- Salt, Cumin, Smoked Paprika, Coriander Powder, Pepper (or whichever seasonings you have available)
- 5g Minced Garlic
- 1/2 Sliced Tomato
- 20g Sliced Red Onion
- Fresh Parsley (optional topping)

Tzatziki Sauce 👇🏼
- 75g Low Fat Greek Yoghurt
- 5g Minced Garlic
- Dill & Salt
- Freshly Grated Cucumber
- Squeeze Of Lemon Juice

Garlic Flatbread 👇🏼
- 60g Self Raising Flour (Brand: Vetta Smart Protein Self Raising Flour - or you can use plain flour mixed with 1 Tsp of baking powder & salt)
- 75g Low Fat Greek Yoghurt 
- Parsley Flakes (optional topping)

If cooking the chicken with the exact method I have in the video bake it in the oven at 220 Degrees Celsius for 20 - 25 Minutes.
OR
To keep it simple you can just cook it regularly on a pan, in the oven, air fryer etc. 

IMPORTANT NOTES 👇🏼
- You can either cook the chicken on a pan, grill, in the oven, air fryer or whichever way you prefer & is easiest. The method I did was placing 2 wooden skewers on a half cut onion then stacking the chicken on top.
- Depending on the brand of yoghurt different ones contain more/ less moisture which can cause the dough to be sticky. If this happens slowly add more flour until you have a consistent you can work with.
- When rolling the dough out make sure to lightly flour your surface beforehand to avoid sticking.
- You don’t have to make the flatbread & can use any store bought one if you like but fresh is always best!

Macros are based on the specific brands of ingredients I used listed above. Brands & certain ingredients can be substituted to your own liking if needed, Macros may vary if you chose to do so. #gyros #highprotein #highproteinmeals #healthyrecipes #easyrecipe #Fitness

title:
you guys NEED to try this easy Chinese honey sesame chicken recipe 🤤🍯🍚 so yum, super easy & high protein!!

Ingredients:
600g chicken breast, diced
2-3 tbsp cornflour
1 tsp each garlic & onion powder
Salt & pepper
1/2 tbsp olive oil
3 cups cooked rice, to serve
1-2 tbsp sesame seeds

Sauce:
4 tbsp honey (80ml)
2 tbs soy sauce (30ml)
1 clove garlic, minced
1-2 tsp sesame oil
1 tsp rice wine/white vinegar 
2/3 cup chicken stock (180ml)
1 tbsp cornflour

Method:
1. Add the chicken to a bowl with corn flour, garlic & onion powder, salt and pepper, mix well to coat. Cook in the air-fryer (at 200C for 20 mins) or fry pan with olive oil until golden.
2. Mix the sauce ingredients together (except corn flour) and add to a pan, bring to the boil. 
3. Mix the cornflour with 1 tbs water until dissolved then add to the pan, mix well and simmer until sauce thickens.
4. Add the cooked chicken and sesame seeds to the pan and coat in the sticky sauce.
5. Serve with steamed rice, green vegetables and garnish with spring onion/sesame seeds.

Macros (serves 4):
476 cals
P 38g
C 63g
F 7g

#easyrecipe #dinnerideas #healthyfood

title:
🍋 Lemon Potato Sheet Pan with Toom Garlic Dip. #partner
.
Looking to eat more plants? My fool proof formula is roasting a bunch of veggies on a sheet pan, and pairing it with a delicious sauce. My go-to is Toom’s Garlic Dip. It’s so versatile (I always have a tub on hand to dip mini carrots into LOL) and is the perfect base for just about any sheet pan wonder. Get yours now at Costco!
.
RECIPE (serves 4)
1 15oz can chickpeas, drained & rinsed 1 cup cherry tomatoes 3 cups mini potatoes, halved
1/3 cup olive oil
1/2 cup cup vegetable broth
1 lemon, juiced
1 teaspoon garlic powder 
1 tablespoon dried oregano
1 tablespoon paprika
1 teaspoon salt
4 tbsp Toom Garlic Dip
. Preheat the oven to 400F.
.
On a baking sheet, add the potatoes, cherry tomatoes, and chickpeas. 
. In a bowl or measuring cup, combine the oil, veg broth, lemon juice and zest, oregano, paprika and salt. Pour the mixture over the potatoes, chickpeas and tomatoes and coat. 
.
Transfer to the oven and roast 20 minutes, then toss. Continue to cook for another 20 minutes until fork tender. 
.
Spread the toom over a serving plate. Sprinkle with fresh parsley to serve over the toom. #recipe #easyrecipe #sheetpanrecipe #easyrecipe #quickrecipe #healthyrecipe #sheetpandinner #easyrecipes #plantbaseddiet

title:
Part 5- Creamy garlic parmesan chicken with mash + greens 🥔 

Protein 60g / Calorie 771 

A comfort food staple !! 

Recipe (Serves 1):

-Rub a baking potato with olive oil and salt, prick with a fork, and cook unwrapped in the air fryer at 200°C for 50 minutes–1 hour, until the skin is crisp and a knife slides through easily. Cut it open, scoop out the flesh, (I pass through a sieve to make sure it’s extra smooth) then  mash with 1 tbsp butter, 2 tbsp milk, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, and black pepper until smooth.
-Season your scored chicken breast with paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, black pepper, and a drizzle of olive oil. Cook scored-side down in a hot pan for 5–6 minutes until golden, then flip and cook the other side until done. Remove and set aside. In the same pan, cook ½ a finely diced shallot for 2–3 minutes until soft, then add a minced garlic clove and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. 
-Pour in 100ml chicken bone broth, let it reduce slightly, then stir in 50ml crème fraîche, 20g grated Parmesan, 1 tsp honey, parsley, chives, a squeeze of lemon juice, and black pepper. Let it bubble gently until thickened, then return the chicken and spoon the sauce over to coat.
-For the beans, heat a pan with a little olive oil, add trimmed green beans, and cook until softened and starting to char. Stir in 1 minced garlic clove, the zest of ½ lemon, juice of ½ lemon, salt, and pepper, tossing until fragrant.
-Serve the chicken sliced over the mustard mash with the garlic and herb cream sauce poured on top, and the lemon garlic beans on the side.

#garlicchicken #mash #comfortfood #easyrecipe #healthyrecipe

-In a bowl, mix 5 quartered cherry tomatoes, 1–2 sliced mini cucumbers, ¼ finely sliced red onion and 1 tbsp sliced olives with 1 tsp olive oil, 1 tsp red wine vinegar, 1 tsp oregano, salt and pepper to make the Greek salad.
-Stir together 2 tbsp 0% Greek yogurt, ½ grated mini cucumber (liquid squeezed out), 1 minced small garlic clove, 1 tsp red wine vinegar, 1 tbsp chopped fresh mint and salt to make the tzatziki.
-Pan-sear the marinated chicken in a hot pan for 5–6 minutes each side until golden and cooked through, rest, then slice and load everything over the split sweet potato with the Greek salad and tzatziki.

title:
💥CHICKEN SHAWARMA LOAF PAN CHICKEN

This truly is the secret to making the easiest, best chicken right at home without turning on a grill.

The chicken is spiced so ridiculously well, the chicken comes out so flavorful and juicy, and you can make a ton of easy meals throughout the week. Use it alongside some roasted vegetables, inside some pita, or you can make high protein bowls with some rice. I used my kaizen high protein low carb rice, but use whatever rice you like depending on your goals!

Here is how to make it:

1 Start with 2.5 lbs boneless chicken thighs. Trim off the excess fat as you wish and place inside a large bowl.

2 Drizzle the chicken with about 1 tbsp of olive oil, then season with a couple pinches of salt and pepper, and some spices. I used 1.5 tbsp garlic powder, 1.5 tbsp sweet paprika, 1/4 to 1/2 tsp cayenne pepper, 1 tbsp oregano, 1 tbsp Aleppo pepper, 1/2 tsp cumin, 1/2 tsp cinnamon. To make the chicken extra juicy, I also add 2 tbsp yogurt, 1.5 tbsp tomato paste, the juice of half large lemon.

3 Mix it super well, then thinly slice 1/2 large yellow onion and mix it in with the chicken. If you can, let this marinate for 2-3 hrs or overnight, but if you want to make it right away, you can.

4 When you’re ready to eat, let the chicken come up to room temp while you pack it inside a loaf pan (the size of my loaf pan is 8.5x4.5x2.5). Place it in the oven for 50-55 mins at 425F.

5 Remove your chicken from the oven, tilt the pan over a glass container to pour out the excess juices. I usually pour this over the chicken before serving, or sometimes use it as a base for soups.

6 Flip the loafpan over a cutting board and cut chicken into strips, and serve it up!

I made an amazing high protein lowcarb chicken shawarma and rice bowl with 55g protein with my @Kaizen Food Company lowcarb rice, a fresh garden salad, and my garlicky white sauce. So easy, and so good!

If you make it, be sure to let me know on SHREDHAPPENS. I share easy high protein recipes, Mediterranean food, and more!

ENJOY!
.
.
.
.

title:
15 MINUTE CREAMY THAI COCONUT COD CURRY
 Creamy, fragrant and properly speedy. The cod steams gently in the curry sauce to become perfectly flakey and gorgeous. The PERFECT midweek meal. 

Serves 2 at approx 490kcal & 26g protein per portion 
 1 pack microwave brown rice 1 carrot 1 courgette 2 cod fillets (or any protein of choice)  1 tin light or full fat coconut milk 1 tbsp red curry paste 2 spring onions 1 tsp honey 1 chicken stock cube 1 tsp fish sauce 1 tsp soy sauce
 Lime & Crispy chilli oil to serve 
 Dry the cod and salt. 
 Add the light coconut milk, red curry paste, spring onions, honey, stock cube, fish sauce and soy sauce to a blender and blitz until smooth.
 Julienne the carrot and courgette, or peel into ribbons.
 Add the rice to a wide pan, top with the veg, then place the cod on top. Pour the sauce over.
 Put the lid on and simmer gently for 8–10 minutes, until the cod is cooked through and flakes easily.
 Serve with a squeeze of lime and a drizzle of crispy chilli oil.
#healthyrecipes #quickrecipes

title:
Home Cooking Sessions: Thai Beef Salad with the most incredible lemongrass dressing. Full recipe and long-form video now up on Substack, link in bio 🇹🇭😍
-
For me, there are very few salads that compare to this one, and a lot of that comes down to the dressing. It’s sharp, sweet, salty and spicy, with layers of heat, citrus and umami that somehow all work together perfectly. It’s incredibly versatile too, so once you make the dressing, you can pair it with all sorts of proteins. 

I used lemongrass in both the dressing and butter baste to bring freshness and that really fragrant citrus note through the beef. The toasted rice powder is another key element here - it adds nuttiness, texture and body whilst helping absorb excess moisture so the salad stays crisp.

There’s plenty of crushing, grinding and layering of flavours in this one, but if you don’t have a mortar and pestle, a food processor works perfectly well too. Full recipe, ingredients and long-form video now live on Substack, link in bio. NF x

title:
You HAVE to try the Japanese curry from One Piece 🏴‍☠️

What’s everyone watching right now? Let me know in the comments 

Ingredients
- chuck roast
-1/3 cup lard
- 1/3 cup flour
- 2 tbsp Japanese curry powder
- 1 tbsp garam masala
- 1 Fuji apple
- 40oz beef stock (not sponsored but I like to mix a tbsp of the @knorr beef base with water)
- 4 small tomatoes
- 2 yellow onions
- 2 gold potatoes
- 2 carrots
- 1/2 cup Greek yogurt or kiefer 
- 1 tbsp ginger garlic paste
- 2 tsp turmeric
- salt and pepper
- medium grain rice

First slice chuck roast into bite size pieces. Season with salt and pepper then add a heaping tbsp of ginger garlic paste and 2 tsp turmeric along with the Greek yogurt. Let marinade for however long your patience can tolerate. 
make the roux by combining equal parts flour and lard, butter, or oil. Stir constantly until it darkens a bit. Not gumbo dark but somewhere between blond and chocolate. 
Add in the curry powder (most places sell the @sbfoodsusa curry powder which is essential for Japanese curry. Again, not sponsored) and the garem masala. Stir to combine and set aside. 
Simmer the tomatoes for a few minutes to make the skin easy to remove. Let cool and optionally scoop out the seeds. It doesn’t matter either way. 
In a large heavy pot, sautee the diced onion until soft add in 1/4 cup sake. Cook until almost completely evaporated or omit this step if you can’t buy alcohol. Pour in the roux. Add in the tomatoes and beef along with beef stock. Let simmer gently for about 2 hours until the beef is tender but not falling apart. Lastly add in the chopped potatoes and carrots and grate 1 Fuji apple directly in. Let simmer until the vegetables are tender and serve with rice!

#onepiece #japanesecurry #sanji #animefood #fyp

title:
Calzone 🥐 from We Bare Bears 🐻🐼🐻‍❄️

Ingredients:
-500g pizza dough
-200ml tomato sauce
-200g mozzarella cheese, shredded
-150g meat of your choice (pepperoni, ham, or sausage)
-150g mushrooms, sliced
-1 egg, beaten (egg wash)
-salt and pepper to taste

Instructions:
Preheat your oven to 200°C (390°F). Divide the dough into 3 equal portions and roll each out into a circle about 25cm wide.

Spread tomato sauce over one half of each dough circle, leaving a 2cm border. Layer on the cheese, meat and mushrooms. Season with salt and pepper. Don't overfill or they'll burst!

Fold the empty half over the filling to form a half-moon. Press the edges firmly and crimp to seal. Brush tops with egg wash.

Place on a parchment-lined tray and bake until golden brown, about 25 minutes. Serve with extra tomato sauce on the side for dipping. Do NOT feed to raccoons. 🦝

title:
Cheesy potato croquettes ✨

The smoked Gouda made them soooo good, turned out better than I expected.

Ingredients 
- 6 russet or Yukon potatoes, peeled and sliced
- 1/3 cup smoked Gouda cheese, shredded
- 1/4 cup parsley, chopped 
- 5 tbsp cornstarch 
- 2 tsp garlic powder 
- 2 tsp onion powder 
- 1 tsp smoked paprika 
- 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)
- 1 tsp salt 
- 1/2 tsp pepper
- 1/2 cup mozzarella, cut into small pieces 
- Fresh parsley for topping

Dredge
- 1 cup panko bread crumbs 
- 1/4 cup parsley, chopped
- 1 tsp garlic powder 
- 1/4 cup all purpose flour (for paste
- 2/3 cup water (for paste)
- 1 egg whisked (season paste with salt and pepper)

Instructions
- Boil potatoes in salted water until fork-tender (about 12–15 min). Drain and mash until smooth.
- Stir in, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne powder, smoked paprika, smoked Gouda, parsley, salt, pepper, and cornstarch.
- Mix well until creamy but firm. Let cool slightly.
- Scoop about 3 tbsp mashed potato mixture into your hand.
- Flatten slightly, place a small cube (or pinch) of mozzarella inside, then roll back into a ball to seal. Place in fridge or freezer for 30-45 minutes.
- Roll each ball in paste, then coat in breadcrumbs. For extra crunch: repeat paste + breadcrumb coating twice.) 
- Heat oil to 350°F (175°C).
- Fry potato croquettes in batches, 2–3 minutes, until golden brown and crispy.
- Drain on wired wrack.
- Sprinkle with extra parsley and salt.

title:
Cowboy butter steak sliders ✨🍔

Ingredients 
Steak
- 2 pounds ribeye or sirloin steak, sliced into strips
- 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce 
- 2 tsp garlic powder 
- 1 tsp soy sauce 
- Salt and pepper to taste (generous amount)
- Smoked provolone cheese
- Avocado oil for searing
- Brioche buns

“Caramelized” onions 
- 2-3 medium yellow onion, sliced
- 1 tsp granulated sugar 
- Heaping pinch of salt

Cowboy butter
- 8 tbsp unsalted butter
- 5 garlic cloves, minced 
- 1 shallot, minced 
- 1/2 lemon, freshly squeezed
- 1 tbsp Dijon mustard 
- 1 heaping tbsp parsley, chopped
- 1 heaping tbsp chives, chopped
- 1 tsp thyme
- 1 tsp cayenne powder (adjust to heat preference 
- 1/2 tsp red chili flakes
- 1/2 tsp smoked paprika 
- Salt to taste 

Garlic butter
- 1/4 cup unsalted butter, melted
- 2 tbsp parsley, freshly chopped 
- 1 heaping tsp garlic powder 
- Salt to taste

Instructions 
- Toss sliced  steak with soy sauce, Worcestershire, garlic powder, and a generous amount of salt & pepper. Set aside.
- Heat a skillet over medium heat with a little oil or butter.
- Add onions, sugar, and salt. Cook 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until soft, golden, and jammy. Remove from pan and set aside.
- Crank heat to medium-high/high. Add steak in a single layer (work in batches if needed).
- Sear 2–3 minutes per side until deeply browned. Remove and set aside. Lower heat to medium.
- Add butter to the same pan. Once melted, add garlic and shallot — cook ~30 seconds until fragrant.
- Stir in lemon juice, Dijon, parsley, chives, thyme, cayenne, chili flakes, smoked paprika, and salt.
- Add steak back to the pan.
- Toss to coat in the butter sauce for 1–2 minutes.
- Preheat your oven to 375°F.
- In an oven-safe baking dish, layer the bottom halves of your sliced brioche buns with smoked provolone cheese.
- Add a generous layer of caramelized onions, followed by your cooked steak, then top with more cheese.
- Place the top halves of the brioche buns on top.
- Cover with foil and bake for 15–20 minutes, or until the cheese is fully melted.
- Remove the foil, brush with garlic butter, and bake uncovered for an additional 4–5 minutes until the buns are golden and crisp.
- Take out of the oven, brush with more garlic butter, and serve warm.

title:
Buffalo chicken cheesy garlic bread ✨🥖

Ingredients
Chicken
- 1.5 lb boneless chicken breast, diced
- 2 tsp Fire & Smoke Society Chicka Licka Bam Bam seasoning 
- 2 tsp garlic powder 
- 2 tsp onion powder
- 1 tsp paprika 
- Salt and black pepper to taste
- Fresh parsley, chopped (for garnish)
- 1/4 cup buffalo sauce 
-  3 tbsp Mexican crema or sour cream 
- 1 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded 

Garlic ranch butter
- 1 stick unsalted butter, softened 
- 2 tbsp parsley, chopped
- 2 tbsp Parmesan cheese 
- 2 tsp garlic paste
- 1 1/2 tsp ranch seasoning 
- 1 tsp garlic powder
- Salt and pepper to taste 

Bread
- 1 large loaf French bread or Italian bread, halved

Instructions
- Preheat oven to 400°F
- In a large bowl, add diced chicken drizzle olive oil and add Chicka Licka Bam Bam seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, salt and pepper to taste. 
- Cover and marinate for 30 minutes.
- Heat a skillet with a little oil over medium-high
- Add chicken in a single layer. Let it sear for 4-5 minutes before stirring.
- Cook until fully done and slightly golden
- Lower heat and mix in buffalo sauce  and crema
- Stir until creamy and fully coated
- Cover and let it simmer for 10 minutes.
- Mix butter ingredients 
- Slice the loaf in half lengthwise, spread on bread, add cheese, diced chicken, and a drizzle of sauce from the chicken.
- Add to the oven for 15-20 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly.
- Garnish with parsley and extra buffalo sauce
- Slice and serve warm.

title:
🌱5 Min. Crispy Chili Peanut Chicken Udon Bowl 💪

In 5 Minuten fertig, richtig lecker und hittet einfach genau den Spot. Speicher dir das Rezept unbedingt ab, mach das nach und lass es dir schmecken 🤤

Diese Udon-Bowl könnten Teil deines Ernährungsplans in meinem 1:1 Coaching sein.
Schau dir gerne die entsprechenden Highlights auf meinem Profil für weitere Infos an oder schreib mir eine DM 👌

Falls du manche Zutaten oder Geräte nicht kennst, kannst du dir einfach das “Zutaten und Equipment” Highlight auf meinem Profil anschauen. Dort findest du die Produkte die ich verwende in einer Liste zusammengefasst 🙌 

Ich poste regelmäßig ähnliche vegane high protein Rezepte, also folge meinem Kanal @ vegan_high_protein um [n](https://www.instagram.com/vegan_high_protein/)ichts zu verpassen 🫶

Was brauchen wir:

Soße:
75g Erdnussbutterpulver (im “Zutaten-Highlight auf meinem Profil) 
 2 El Crispy Chili Öl
Saft 1/2 Zitrone
1 gerieben Knoblauchzehe
ca. 120ml Wasser
2 El Sojasauce
1 Tl brauner Zucker

160g Hähnchenalternative (bei mir Endori BBQ)
300g Udon Nudeln (gekocht)
120g Edamame 

Das Rezept:

1: Alle Zutaten für die Soße verrühren und zur Seite stellen

2: Die Hähnchenalternative anbraten, den Herd ausstellen, die restlichen Zutaten ergänzen und gut verrühren 

3: Genießen 

Gesamtnährwerte: 

Kcal: 1260

Fett: 31g
Kohlenhydrate: 116g
Eiweiß: 120g 

#veganuary #veganuary2026 #vegandeutschland #veganhighprotein #proteinrezepte

400g cannellini beans, drained

Handful chives, chopped (optional)

1 tbsp capers, chopped (optional)

Mash the cannellini beans in a bowl with the shallot, garlic, chopped capers, chives, miso paste, lemon zest and until you’ve got a chunky, spreadable mix.

title:
The OG veggie meatball 😌😌😌 move over meat alts, tofu is THAT GIRL!!

Makes 12-15 balls 
300g firm tofu, drained and water removed 
1 tbsp chia seeds + 2 tbsp water
3 spring onions, chopped
2 tbsp red curry paste  
1.5 inch ginger, grated 
2 cloves garlic, minced 
1 tbsp soy sauce/tamari 
2 tbsp corn flour 
35g desiccated coconut, toasted
1 lime, zested

For the sauce 
2 tbsp Thai red curry paste
1/2 tin coconut milk 
1 tbsp soy sauce/tamari 
Juice of 1 lime, to serve 

Mix the chia seeds with the water and set aside for a few minutes to gel.

Remove the tofu from the water and then squeeze out as much water as possible. Crumble into a large bowl so it forms very small pieces, then add the spring onions, red curry paste, coconut, grated ginger, garlic, soy sauce and lime zest. Add the chia mixture and mix everything together.

Add in the corn flour and stir until the mixture comes together and holds its shape. Season well.

Scoop out portions of around 30g and roll into meatballs using your hands. If the mix is too dry and does not stick together, add a splash of water. If the mix is too wet and sticky and leaves residue on you hands, add a little extra corn flour. 

Heat a generous layer of oil in a large frying pan over a medium heat. Add the meatballs and shallow fry for 5–7 minutes, turning regularly until golden and crisp on all sides. Remove from the pan and set aside. 

Wipe out the pan, then add the red curry paste and fry for a minute until fragrant. Pour in the coconut milk and soy sauce, stir well and let it simmer for a few minutes until slightly thickened. Take off the heat and finish with a squeeze of fresh lime juice, and add the meatballs back in.

title:
Deli slices… out of tofu?!? Welcome back to OG Vegan, this tofu ‘bacon’ is a certified classic. Meal preppable, and one small tweak to make gluten free 😌

Makes 3 ‘BLT’s
For the bacon
1 block extra firm tofu 
3 tbsp tamari
2 tbsp maple syrup
1 tbsp balsamic vinegar
1 tbsp olive oil
1 tbsp smoked paprika
1 tsp garlic granules
Pinch smoked salt (optional)

To serve (per sando)
2 slices sourdough (of GF bread)
2 tbsp vegan mayo 
1 salad tomato, sliced
2 leaves lettuce 

Whisk together the tamari, maple syrup, balsamic vinegar, oil, garlic granules and smoked paprika in a shallow dish and season with smoked salt. Slice the tofu into thin rashers using a mandolin or peeler and add into the marinade, mix until all slices are fully covered. 

Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium high heat. Add the tofu in a single layer, working in batches if needed, and cook until deep golden and caramelised (this will only take a minute or two) before flipping and repeating on the other side.

Toast the bread, then spread the vegan mayo generously over both slices. Layer up the lettuce on the bottom slice, followed by the tomato, then pile on the tofu bacon. Top with the second slice, press down gently and serve straight away.

title:
🍄‍🟫 Creamy Mushroom Chickpea Soup 🥣

Full recipe below and in the PlantHabit app 📱

5 plant groups in one meal 🌿  

🧅 Ingredients:
- 2 Tbsp olive oil  
- 8 oz mushrooms, sliced  
- 1 medium yellow onion, chopped 
- 1 tsp salt  
- 1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, rinsed and drained  
- 3 cups veggie broth  
- 1 tsp Italian seasoning
- 1 can (13.5 oz) light coconut milk   
- 2 Tbsp lemon juice
- 2 cups spinach or kale 

🍞 To Serve:
- 4 slice whole-grain bread, toasted
- 0.25 tsp chipotle chili flakes (optional)

✅ STEPS
1. Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium-high.  
2. Add the mushrooms, onion, and salt. Cook until the mushrooms release moisture, 4–5 minutes.  
3. Stir in the chickpeas, veggie broth, and Italian seasoning. Bring to a boil.  
4. Reduce heat and simmer for 6–8 minutes to blend flavors.  
5. Stir in the coconut milk and lemon juice. Adjust salt and pepper to taste.
6. Add the spinach and let it wilt, 1–2 minutes.  
7. Serve warm with whole grain toast. Garnish with chili flakes, if using. 

📝 NOTES
- Kale holds it’s color better if you want a photogenic green pop. 
- Save a few cooked mushrooms for garnish.
- Slice a little toast into croutons for garnish.

title:
Vegan Lemon Pepper Wings 

✨️I love experimenting in the kitchen. This recipe came out better than expected! Next time, I think I will wrap them in rice paper & brush them with bbq sauce & bake them! 😋 If you try this recipe, let me know how it turns out 😊✨️

🌱Ingredients🌱
• 2 cans Jackfruit 
• 1/4-1 cup vital wheat gluten
• 2 tbsp psyllium husk or flaxseed meal
• 1 tbsp nutritional yeast 
• 1 tbsp vegan chicken bouillon powder
• 1 tsp garlic powder 
• 1 tbsp oil (I used grapeseed)
• 1 tsp vegan worcestershire sauce 
• salt to taste 

🌱Sauce🌱
• Plant butter
• lemon juice
• lemon zest
• lemon pepper seasoning
• hot sauce (optional)
• sweetner of your choice (optional)

✨️Instructions✨️
• Rinse Jackfruit & squeeze out liquid. Place in food processor. Then add dry & wet ingredients. Blend until desired consistency. Slowly add in vital wheat gluten until it holds shape. 
• Mold mixture into desired shape. Place in freezer for about 20-30 min. 
• Make a wet & dry batter(check my page for recipe).
• Heat oil to 375°F & fry until golden & crispy.
• Toss in sauce & enjoy 💜

title:
It’s 2026 can we all agree that vegans don’t have protein deficiencies yet? 🌱

It’s one of the most common misconceptions I still hear, so here’s a breakdown of the protein sources in this dish:

• Lentil Pasta: 17g protein per 100g
• Peas: 5.7g protein per 100g
•Tempeh: 22g protein per 100g
•Pumpkin seeds: 24g protein per 100g
•Sunflower seeds: 20g protein per 100g
•Silken tofu: 7g protein per 100g
•Cashews: 18g protein per 100g
•Nutritional yeast: 47g protein per 100g

That’s 8 plant based protein sources, totalling around 145g of protein in the full recipe and almost 50g per serving!

Pasta sauce:
50g wild garlic 
50g toasted cashews
40g nutritional yeast
20g rocket
250g peas
1 garlic clove
100g silken tofu
Salt and pepper (to taste)
½ lemon juice
25ml olive oil
1 vegetable stock cube
100ml pasta water

This pasta sauce was inspired by and adapted from @bosh.tv rocket, pea and pistachio pesto linguine - a recipe from their new cookbook ‘More Plants’ which I highly recommend for anyone looking to eat more plant protein and fibre! 

Tempeh:
1 block tempeh
1/4 cup pumpkin & sunflower seeds
1 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp maple syrup
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp nutritional yeast
1 tbsp smoked paprika
1 tsp garlic granules
Pinch of salt & pepper

Method:
1. Prep and blend all the pasta sauce ingredients, adding pasta water once the pasta is cooked
2. Cook the pasta (I used a pack of plants 215g red lentil pasta)
3. Chop, season and air fry the tempeh & seeds at 200°C for 8-10 mins
4. Stir the sauce through the pasta and heat gently
5. Plate everything up and enjoy!

title:
Episode No. 7 of NO BORING BEANS || Marry Me Beans 

Be sure to follow @dietitiandebbie for more bean recipes that are anything but boring!

These are my vegan marry me beans—it’s a one skillet dish that is creamy, flavorful, and packed with plant-based protein and fiber. This version uses coconut milk (or cashew cream) to add creaminess without the dairy. This one is perfect paired with some sourdough or pasta.

Marry Me Beans
Makes 4 servings

INGREDIENTS:
2 1/2 - 3 cups cooked butter beans (2 cans, drained)
1 tablespoon olive oil
3-4 cloves garlic, minced
1 (7 oz) jar sun-dried tomatoes, drained and roughly chopped
3/4 cup cashew cream or coconut milk
1/2 cup vegetable broth
1/2 cup grated vegan parmesan cheese 
1 teaspoon Italian seasoning 
1/2 teaspoon chili flakes
Fresh basil

DIRECTIONS
Cook beans butter beans according to package directions. 
Add olive oil, garlic, and sun-dried tomatoes to a large skillet with tall sides. Sauté for 2-3 minutes or until garlic is fragrant. 
Stir in the coconut milk, vegetable broth, parmesan, Italian seasoning, chili flakes. Bring to a simmer. 
Add the beans and simmer for 3-5 minutes or until beans are heated through. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Garnish with fresh basil to serve.

title:
Probably the BEST thing you can make with just 4 easy to find pantry ingredients. Trust me when I say this, you do not need to buy overpriced shop bought treats that are full of ultra processed ingredients - make this millionaire caramel slab instead, it’s perfection 🤌🏼

Go try it for yourself, it’s so easy and SO good.

Here’s how 👩‍🍳 

Base
🔹1 cup ground almonds 
🔹1/3 cup cashew butter 
🔹1/4 cup maple syrup 
Caramel 
🔹1/3 cup cashew butter 
🔹1/3 cup maple syrup 
Topping
🔹 1 cup chocolate chips 
🔹 2 tbsp cashew butter 

▪️mix the base ingredients in a bowl then place in a lined loaf tin or mould and flatten down with a spoon 
▪️mix caramel ingredients together and spread on top of the base 
▪️melt chocolate in a double boiler or microwave stirring every 30 seconds then stir in the peanut butter and pour over the base
▪️chill in the fridge until set (around 30 mins) then cut into slices and enjoy!
Love, Mrs H xx

title:
This spicy vegan “tuna” with crunchy cucumber and rice is such a good combo😋🫶🏻🥒🍚

Spicy “tuna” cucumber sushi

Ingredients:

For the cucumber base:

• 2 large cucumbers
• about 1½ cups cooked sushi rice

For the “tuna” filling:

• 1 can (430 g) chickpeas, drained and rinsed
• 1 pickle, finely chopped
• 1 celery stalk, very finely chopped
• 2 tbsp onion, very finely chopped
• 1 nori sheet, finely chopped
• 1 tbsp mustard
• 2 tbsp vegan mayo
• Salt to taste

Toppings:

• 1 jalapeño, sliced
• Teriyaki sauce
• Spicy sauce
• Sesame seeds
• Green onion, chopped

For serving:
• Soy sauce

How to make:

1. Cut the cucumbers in half lengthwise and scoop out the seeds with a spoon to create boats.
2. Fill each cucumber half with sushi rice, pressing gently so it holds its shape.
3. In a bowl, mash the chickpeas with a fork until flaky.
4. Add the pickle, celery, onion, nori, mustard, vegan mayo, and salt. Mix well.
5. Spoon the chickpea “tuna” mixture over the rice.
6. Top with sliced jalapeño.
7. Drizzle with teriyaki sauce and spicy sauce.
8. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and green onion.
9. Slice into sushi pieces and serve with soy sauce.

#vegansushi #cucumbersushi #quicksushi #spicytuna #veganrecipes

title:
MOROCCAN STYLE CAULIFLOWER!🍅
This cauliflower dish tastes like Moroccan fish! Perfect for Shavuot as a vegetarian dish🍃
Share this with someone you love! 🤍
Follow @ruhamasfood for more recipes.
Check out my website: RuhamasFood.com.
RECIPE BELOW 👇

Recipe:
Ingredients:
1 cauliflower, sliced into “steaks” 
4 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil 
1/2 tablespoon of sweet paprika 
1/2 tablespoon of salt 
1/2 tablespoon of cumin seeds
1/2 tablespoon of caraway seeds 
1 teaspoon of ground black pepper 
1/2 teaspoon of crushed red pepper 
4 Roma tomatoes, sliced 
1 red pepper, sliced to strips 
1/2 lemon, sliced (without the seeds)
1 jalapeño pepper, sliced 
3 garlic cloves, sliced 
3 tablespoons of tomato paste
1 teaspoon of sugar 
1 cup of water 
Handful of fresh cilantro 

Ingredients for the red oil: 
1/2 teaspoon of red paprika 
3 minced garlic cloves
1/4 cup of extra virgin olive oil 
Mix all the ingredients in a bowl 

Method: 
1. On medium heat, add the olive oil, salt, cumin seeds, caraway seeds, ground black pepper, and crushed red pepper to a pan. Warm the spices for about 30 seconds and mix to release their flavor.
2. Add the sliced tomatoes, red pepper, jalapeño pepper, lemon slices, and garlic. Let them fry for 2–3 minutes until the vegetables begin to soften.
3. Stir in the tomato paste and sugar, then pour in the water and let the sauce cook for about 5 minutes.
4. Arrange the cauliflower “steaks” on top of the sauce. Spoon the red oil over each piece, sprinkle cilantro around the pan, and gently shake the pan from side to side to coat everything.
5. Continue cooking on the stove for about 5 minutes, then transfer the pan to a convection broil at 450°F for 8–10 minutes, until the cauliflower is golden and crispy. 
Enjoy! Ruhama 🤍

5. Continue cooking on the stove for about 5 minutes, then transfer the pan to a convection broil at 450°F for 8–10 minutes, until the cauliflower is golden and crispy. 
Enjoy! Ruhama 🤍

title:
Vegan Garlic Naan (Stovetop)

Ingredients
	•	4 ½ cups all-purpose flour
	•	2 cups warm water
	•	1 teaspoon yeast
	•	1 teaspoon salt
	•	1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil
	•	1 teaspoon sugar

⸻

Instructions
	1.	Activate the yeast
In a large bowl, combine warm water, yeast, and sugar. Let it sit for 5–10 minutes until slightly foamy.
	2.	Make the dough
Add flour and salt. Mix with a spoon until it starts to come together, then knead by hand or with a mixer for 5–8 minutes until smooth.
	3.	Knead & rest
Lightly oil your hands and knead the dough a few more times. Cover with a warm towel and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until doubled in size.
	4.	Shape the naan
Divide the dough into balls. Cover with a damp warm cloth and let them rest for 15 minutes.
	5.	Cook
Heat a grill pan or regular pan over medium heat and lightly oil it.
Roll or stretch each dough ball into an oval shape.
Cook for 1–2 minutes until bubbles form and the bottom is golden. Flip and cook another 1–2 minutes.
	6.	Finish
Brush with garlic topping and serve warm.

⸻

Garlic Topping
	•	3 tablespoons olive oil
	•	3–4 cloves garlic (minced)
	•	2 tablespoons fresh cilantro (chopped)

Instructions:
Mix garlic and oil together, then stir in the cilantro. Brush over hot naan right after cooking.

title:
Crispy Buffalo Tofu Bites
-
As someone who grew up obsessed with chicken nuggets/wings...this plant based version is truly such a comfort food, without being fried🤗
-
Recipe:
1. Boil a pot of stock with added salt(veg, chicken, whatever stock you prefer to add flavour) then reduce to medium heat.
2. Tear a block of extra firm tofu into chunks, then dump into the stock, cooking for 6 mins or so, then drain.
3. Mix together cashew milk (or another milk alt) and 2Tbsp of cornstarch, then add in Garlic Plus blend (sub with onion and garlic powder), oregano, parsley, cayenne, salt and pepper.
4. Coat your tofu chunks first in flour, then in the seasoned mixture^ then in crushed cornflakes, squeezing the flakes onto the tofu to fully coat them.
5. Place the breaded tofu on an oiled baking sheet and bake in the oven at 450F for 15 mins, flipping halfway through.
6. While they bake, stir together 1/2 cup franks hot sauce with 1/4 cup melted VF butter, 2Tbsp of honey or maple syrup, and a dash of garlic to make a quick buffalo sauce.
7. Once the tofu is done cooking, toss in the buffalo sauce and serve with dip! I used yogurt/ garlic plus blend/lemon juice for mine:)
-
#healthy #veganrecipes #dairyfree #football #comfortfood

title:
🍛Easy 1 pan chickpea curry @healthy_floflo
Naan or rice? What would you have this with?😋🤗

Reason to love this recipe:
✅ you only need one pan
✅ creamy and fragrant
✅ plant based
✅ comforting but healthy
✅ high fibre

Ingredients:
1 yellow onion
1 tbsp grated ginger
3-5 cloves garlic
2 tbsp curry powder
1 tsp cumin
½ tsp turmeric
½ tsp paprika
Salt to taste
1 can chopped tomatoes
1 can coconut milk (I used a light version)
1 can chickpeas 
1 tbsp nut butter (I have used Peanut butter )
1 handful of frozen spinach

Instructions:
🍛In a pan add some oil until it starts sizzling.

🍛Add garlic, onion and all the spices.

🍛Cook for a few minute until the onions starts to soften.

🍛Add, chopped tomatoes, coconut milk and the nut butter. 
Cook for 5-10 mins. 
It will look very liquid to begin with but don’t worry, it will dry out while cooking and it will be even more full of flavour, thanks to the slow simmering.

🍛Now add chickpeas and frozen spinach.
Cook until the spinach are completely defrosted and well cooked.

Enjoy alone and straight from the pan with some naan bread or with some rice… what would you go for?🤗

title:
VEGANUARY 20/25 🌱 
25 recipes in 25 minutes: One Pot Dal 🍛 

I LOVE the Indian cuisine, it’s so versatile and, above all, super vegan-friendly… simply delicious! 😋
RECIPE (3-4 servings, 25min preparation time):
-2 cloves garlic, minced
-1 thumb-sized piece of ginger
Sauté in a little oil.
-1 teaspoon each of cumin, ground coriander, curry powder
-1/2 tsp paprika powder and if you want some chili
-2 tbsp tomato paste
-200g red lentils (1 cup)
Roast briefly.
-300ml canned coconut milk
-300ml water
-Salt to taste
-Juice of half a lime
Mix well, cover and simmer on medium heat for 15-20 minutes.
Serve with cilantro, lime and naan.

title:
Do you think Gordon would like my tofu scramble recipe? #veganrecipes #tofu #ramsayreacts @Gordon Ramsay 

👇 TOFU SCRAMBLE RECIPE 👇

INGREDIENTS:
1-14 oz. Package of Firm Tofu
1/3 cup Nutritional Yeast
1/3 cup almond milk
1/2 cup spinach

Spice Blend:
2 tsp oregano
2 tsp minced onion
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp mustard powder
1 tsp turmeric
1/4 tsp salt (use black salt for more eggy taste)
1/4 tsp black pepper

DIRECTIONS:

1. Add Tofu: Crumble the tofu into the pan. Use your hands to pick it apart or you can mash it with a fork. Continue cooking for about 3 minutes on medium heat before the next step. Pro tofu tip: squeeze the tofu over the sink to drain out some water. I usually do it one handful at a time.

2. Add the Spices: Add the spice blend and cook for 6-7 minutes. 

3. Add the Rest: Add in nutritional yeast and almond milk. Cook for about 2-3 minutes then. Add the spinach, cook 1 more minute. Enjoy! #vegan #gordonramsay

title:
When I say it was sooo hard for me and my hubs not to sit up and eat this whole pan in one sitting lol. This “Marry Me” Chickpea Dip is AMAZING! S/O to @Delina Gray for the inspiration to make this 🫶🏾

Ingredients:

1 tbsp plant butter 
1/2 a yellow onion, diced 
4 garlic cloves, minced 
1 jar of sun-dried tomatoes, drained 
2 15oz cans of chickpeas, drained and rinsed
10oz bag of frozen spinach 
1 @knorr vegetable dip seasoning packet 
@iamtabithabrown Very Good Garlic Seasoning 
dried basil
dried oregano 
vegan mayo 
vegan cream cheese 
vegan parmesan 
vegetable broth
dairy-free mozzarella 

How it all comes together: 

Sautee onion, garlic, and sundried tomatoes in plant-butter in a large rimmed skillet until fragrant and starting to soften (about 2 minutes) 

Add in chickpeas, seasonings, spinach, vegan mayo, vegan cream cheese, and vegan parmesan, and mix well to combine. 

Once mixed, pour in 1/2 cup of vegetable broth at a time until it reaches your desired, dippable consistency (I didn’t measure as I was pouring, but would guesstimate I used a little over a cup) 

Transfer mixture to an oven safe dish and top with dairy-free mozzarella cheese, making sure to spray with a little cooking spray or spritz a little water/broth over the top of it so it can get as melty as possible

Bake at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 15-20 minutes until hot and bubbling. 

🥖 we enjoyed ours with a sliced up warm French baguette but I bet this would be fye with some pita chips, pretzels crisp, or even as a pasta sauce too! 

#vegancooking #whatveganseat #chickpeas #plantbasedrecipes #plantbasedtiktok #cookingvideos

title:
🥵 Hot Hunny Crispy Tofu Sandwich

Crispy Tofu:

1 block firm tofu, 
cut into sandwich-size pieces
Marinade: Soy sauce
Garlic powder
Splash vinegar

Coating: Cornflour
Nutritional yeast
Salt + pepper

Toss the tofu in marinade and leave to marinate while you prep everything else.

Then cover in coating and pan fry in oil until golden and crisp on both sides.

Pinch salt
Pinch Fresh thyme

🥒 Creamy cucumber dill salad:

Cucumber, chopped
Lettuce, shredded
2 tbsp yoghurt
1 tbsp mayo
1 tsp mustard
Squeeze lemon juice
Fresh dill
Salt + pepper

title:
Complete dinner in under 30 minutes✨
One pot, simple ingredients, minimal cleanup, and a dinner everyone actually gets excited about. Juicy chicken thighs, cozy bowtie pasta, and the freshest crunchy side salad. These are the kinds of meals that end up on repeat in my kitchen because they’re easy, comforting, and just so good🥰
Link to products used https://www.amazon.com/shop/sivanskitchen/photo/amzn1.shoppablemedia.v1.fabf5ba8-3f03-4100-adc8-e7ccbc402e7a?ref_=aipsfphoto

Ingredients 🐓🍝🥗

One pot chicken & pasta
1½ pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs
1 onion, sliced
¼ cup olive oil
1 teaspoon salt
1 teaspoon paprika
1 teaspoon garlic powder
½ teaspoon black pepper
1 package 16 oz bowtie pasta
4 cups chicken broth or any broth you love
½ cup tomato paste

Side salad 🥬🥒🌶️
1 head iceberg lettuce
3 Persian cucumbers, chopped
1 sweet yellow pepper, chopped
5 radishes, sliced
Olive oil
Fresh lemon juice
Salt and pepper

Instructions

Place the chicken thighs in a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt, paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper. Mix until evenly coated.

Heat a large pot over medium heat. Add the chicken and sear for a few minutes on each side until golden. Scatter the sliced onion right over the chicken and let it soften in all the flavor.

In a separate bowl or measuring cup, whisk together the broth and tomato paste until smooth.

Once the chicken is nicely browned, add the bowtie pasta directly into the pot. Pour the tomato broth mixture right over the chicken and pasta and bring everything to a boil. Cover, reduce to a simmer, and cook for about 10 minutes until the pasta is tender and the chicken is fully cooked through.

While everything cooks, chop the lettuce, cucumbers, yellow pepper, and radishes. Drizzle with olive oil and fresh lemon juice, season with salt and pepper, and toss.

That’s it. One pot, one fresh salad, and a full comforting dinner on the table in under 30 minutes💛

#sivanskitchen #easyrecipes #onepotmeal #dinnerideas #quickmeals

title:
10 MINUTE PEANUT BUTTER + CHILLI CRISP NOODLES 🤤

if you’ve got 10 minutes to make dinner tonight, but aren’t sure what to cook, this is what you should be eating this evening - speedy peanut butter + chilli crisp noodles 🌶️

when I saw @vegscratchkitchen make these, I knew I had to give them a go. and oh my lord, they did not disappoint - they are RIDICULOUSLY delicious + indulgent 😍

you can find the full recipe on his feed, but as a rough guide:

2 tbsp crunchy peanut butter (I like @manilife_ deep roast)
1 tbsp minced garlic
1 tbsp minced ginger 
2 tbsp finely sliced spring onion
2 tbsp finely diced shallot
2 tsp chilli crisp (I like @redpanda.food )
2 tbsp minced garlic toasted sesame seeds 
2 tbsp soy sauce
2 tbsp rice wine vinegar
80ml hot neutral oil (I used sunflower)

2 portions noodles of choice
1 small red chilli, sliced

get all your ingredients in a frying pan, then heat your oil. once hot + starting to smoke, pour over the aromatics, whisking well to combine. 

cook your noodles according to packet instructions, reserving a little noodle cooking liquid. toss the noodles through the sauce, loosening with a little liquid if required. garnish with more spring onion, red chilli + sesame seeds. 

enjoy! and let me know if you give it a go in the comments 👇 

#noodles #easydinner #quickrecipes #easyrecipe

title:
✨Cheesy chicken fajita slider buns 🍔 ingredients:

* Chicken: 500 g (cut into cubes)
* Oil: 1/3 cup
* Ginger garlic paste: 1 tbsp
* Capsicum: 1/2 (chopped)
* White onion: 1 (chopped)
* Tomato paste: 1 tbsp
* Cream cheese: 1 tbsp
* Ketchup: 4–5 tbsp
* Sweet chilli sauce: 4–5 tbsp

Spices:

* paprika powder: 1 tsp
* Salt: 1 tsp
* Achar gosht masala: 1 tsp
* Coriander powder: 1/2 tsp
* Cumin powder: 1/2 tsp
* Dried parsley: 1/2 tsp
* Oregano: 1/2 tsp
* Red chilli flakes: 1/2 tsp

For Assembly:

* Slider buns: 6
* Mozzarella cheese slices
* Mozzarella cheese (grated)
* Spring onion (chopped)

Burger Sauce:

* Mayonnaise: 4–5 tbsp
* Ketchup: 1 tbsp
* Hot sauce: 1 tsp
* Mustard sauce: 1 tbsp
* Sweet chilli sauce: 2 tbsp
* Cayenne powder: 1/2 tsp
* Salt: a pinch
* Dried parsley: 1/2 tsp
* Mix everything well

For the Butter Coating:

* Melted butter: 5–6 tbsp
* Paprika powder: 1/2 tsp
* Fresh parsley: 1 tbsp (chopped)
* Garlic: 2–3 cloves (minced)

Instructions:

* Heat oil in a pan.
* Add chicken, ginger garlic paste, and all the spices. Cook until the chicken is done.
* Add onion and capsicum and cook for 2–3 minutes.
* Add tomato paste, cream cheese, ketchup, and sweet chilli sauce.
* Mix well and cook for another 2 minutes on medium heat.
* Place slider buns in an oven-safe dish.
* Add mozzarella slices, chicken filling, burger sauce, spring onion, and grated mozzarella cheese. Close the buns.
* Brush the tops with melted butter mixed with parsley, paprika, and minced garlic.
* Bake at 160°C for 7–8 minutes, or until the cheese melts.
